chunks: The Shaykh, the Jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd narrated to us, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), who said:

Fasting in Sha'ban is a treasure stored for the servant on the Day of Resurrection. There is no servant who increases his fasting in Sha'ban except that Allah rectifies the affairs of his livelihood and protects him from the evil of his enemy. And indeed, the minimum reward for one who fasts a single day in Sha'ban is that Paradise becomes obligatory for him.

key_terms.الجنة: Paradise (Jannah) — the eternal reward in the afterlife
key_terms.القيامة: The Day of Resurrection (Qiyamah) — the Day of Judgment
key_terms.ذخر: Treasure, depository — spiritual savings stored for the Hereafter
key_terms.شعبان: Sha'ban — the eighth month of the Islamic calendar, preceding Ramadan, considered sacred in Shia tradition
key_terms.صيام: Fasting (sawm/siyam) — voluntary fasting outside Ramadan, especially recommended in Sha'ban

ai.seo_question: What are the rewards of fasting in Sha'ban according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) encouraged fasting during the month of Sha'ban, the month immediately preceding Ramadan. He described three rewards: it serves as a spiritual treasure stored for the Day of Judgment, Allah improves the fasting person's worldly livelihood and shields them from enemies, and even a single day of fasting guarantees entry into Paradise. This teaching was delivered in a scholarly gathering (majlis) held on a Friday evening in Sha'ban 367 AH, reflecting the Shia tradition of emphasizing voluntary fasting in this sacred month as spiritual preparation for Ramadan.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd narrated to us from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from `Abdullah b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Fasting in Sha`ban is a depository for the worshiper on the Day of Resurrection. There is no worshiper who increases his fasting in Sha`ban except that Allah rectifies the affairs of his livelihood and suffices him from the evil of his enemies. The minimum [reward] for one who fasts a day in Sha`ban is that Paradise will become obligatory for him.
